verdict.rationale: incident.io documents user-configured Workflows that run automatically on incident events, such as auto-publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. Its Investigations agent also starts on its own when an incident is declared and keeps re-assessing as new signals arrive, with no human prompting. missing for 10: detailed Workflows documentation covering the range of triggers, conditions and actions; evidence of recurring or scheduled background automations rather than purely event-triggered ones; independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
Automatically updating your status page means you can make your customers aware of problems immediately, and remove a step from your incident response process.
The moment an incident is declared, an investigation gathers context from across your stack
Investigations runs on a purpose-built harness that re-assesses as new signals land
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
